nodes.label: Operator
nodes.desc: A human operator starts an unattended run from their terminal. Everything downstream is dispatched by the loop — never the other way around.
nodes.meta: Run loop.sh run, or inspect with --once --dry-run.

nodes.label: GitHub Projects v2
nodes.desc: The board is the single source of truth for what to work on next. loop polls items whose Status = Ready — there is no status:ready label; the board field is authoritative.
nodes.meta: Set up once with issue-to-project --init.

nodes.label: seed-issue
nodes.desc: Prepares a hand-filed issue for the loop: stamps the to-issues provenance footer so the KEY can be derived, adds status:ready-for-dev, moves the board card to Ready, and for new work creates a minimal specs/<N>-<slug>/ folder.
nodes.out: Labelled + board-promoted issue; seed specs/ folder; for plan-tier:light dispatches light-planner
nodes.meta: Bypasses to-issues for manually filed work.

nodes.label: light-planner
nodes.desc: For a thin plan-tier:light issue, writes a full plan.md (non-empty Tasks + Acceptance criteria). If the body is too thin it writes no plan and returns a thin-body signal to re-tier.
nodes.out: plan.md, or a thin-body R1 signal
nodes.ctx: Runs locally under the operator's Claude at seed time — reviewable in git before dispatch.

nodes.label: loop
nodes.desc: Single-threaded polling driver. Each tick: checks ~/.claude/HALT (HALT-000), runs pre-poll passes (reconcile-orphaned → auto-seed → promote-ready → worktree-reap → HALT-007B check), polls the board for Ready issues, filters in-flight, then classifies & dispatches — type:change → makato-change:orchestrate, everything else → the PO-agent.
nodes.meta: Picks up the next item only when workflow-state reaches current_phase: done.

nodes.label: session-status
nodes.desc: On session open, prints one banner line per active workflow (issue, phase, budget %, HALT count) and a global HALT-ACTIVE line if the HALT file exists.
nodes.meta: Wired as a SessionStart hook in consumer repos.

nodes.label: po-agent
nodes.desc: Autonomous outer-loop driver for a single issue. Dispatches makato-build skills in order, polls CI and reviews, routes merge conflicts, and terminates only on a merged PR or a documented HALT. Sole writer of workflow-state.json.
nodes.inp: One Ready issue (KEY, ISSUE, REPO, BRANCH) from loop
nodes.out: A merged PR, or a HALT code + needs-human-review
nodes.ctx: Its own headless Claude session (claude -p, MAKATO_HEADLESS=1) per issue, inside a dedicated git worktree. Never edits target source — orchestrates only.

nodes.label: kill-switch
nodes.desc: Composed at every outer-loop boundary: HALT file (HALT-000), claude-halt label (HALT-009), per-task & daily token budgets (HALT-007), context ceiling (HALT-007B → handoff), outer_iteration >= 3 (HALT-008).
nodes.out: Continue, or a HALT code that stops the run
nodes.meta: HALT-007B forks a fresh resumed session via context-handoff.sh.

nodes.label: workflow-state.json
nodes.desc: Per-issue state file the PO-agent solely writes. Tracks current_phase, sub_tasks[], token budgets, outer_iteration, halt_audit[], PR number, worktree path, lessons_learned[].
nodes.inp: Writes from po-agent at every phase transition
nodes.out: current_phase read by loop's in-flight filter
nodes.meta: specs/<KEY>-<slug>/workflow-state-<issue>.json

nodes.label: context-summariser
nodes.desc: Produces a <=500-token session summary for a HALT-007B context-ceiling handoff — the first user message the fresh Claude session injects.
nodes.ctx: Non-technical handoff agent. skill_routing: disabled — no skill injection, no F4 telemetry.

nodes.label: task-file-scout
nodes.desc: Per-task read-only file scout. Pre-reads up to 8 predicted files plus bundle-resolved rule files and returns a ~500-token summary injected into the coder's context.
nodes.inp: A sub-task's predicted files + rule files
nodes.ctx: Read-only, task-file-specific. Distinct from build's repo-wide knowledge-scout.

nodes.label: CI poll & review
nodes.desc: build-fix-ci owns SHA-bound CI inspection and TDD/goal/sensor/metadata repair, then review, verification and existing-PR push. PO consumes current-head green before review and after later pushes. CHANGES_REQUESTED -> human-review fix loop (HALT-010 after MAX cycles).
nodes.inp: Open PR + CI check runs + review state
nodes.out: Advance to merge, dispatch a fix, or HALT
nodes.meta: CI repairs continue while progressing (optional explicit cap); blocked, timed out or stalled repairs never approve CI. Merge-conflict cycles >= 3 -> HALT-008.

nodes.label: resolve-pr-conflict
nodes.desc: Rebases the branch, falls back to git merge -X ours, and force-pushes on a clean tree. Bounded by merge_conflict_cycles; exhaustion -> HALT-008 with the worktree retained.

nodes.label: documentation-agent
nodes.desc: Post-merge doc pass triggered by GHA once per merged PR: appends a CHANGELOG entry, conditionally updates the README on public-API change, closes issues, advances the board to Done. Never edits source.

nodes.label: build-start
nodes.desc: Entry point for an interactive build session: validates git state and spec prerequisites, captures implementation mode, initializes the build log, kicks off build-refine.
nodes.inp: A story KEY + clean git state
nodes.out: Initialised build.jsonl; hands off to build-refine
nodes.meta: Autonomous runs skip this — the PO-agent starts at build-refine.

nodes.label: build-refine
nodes.desc: Bridges a story/issue into an implementation plan: tasks, file targets, unit/integration test strategy, acceptance mapping.
nodes.inp: A shaped story + repo constraints (via knowledge-scout)
nodes.meta: R1 failure -> HALT-STRUCTURAL.

nodes.label: build-grill-with-docs
nodes.desc: Aligns implementation-plan terminology to the codebase domain model — enriches glossary.md, records ADR decisions.

nodes.label: knowledge-scout
nodes.desc: Repo-wide, plan-time discovery agent. Calls inject-context + inject-skills at Step 0, locates SPECS_ROOT, reads the index, synthesizes Hard Constraints and Standards.

nodes.label: inject-context
nodes.desc: Resolves changed file paths against context-bundles.yml and returns an ordered, deduplicated list of rule files. Glob-specificity first, default bundle last.
nodes.out: Ordered rule-file paths for knowledge-scout to pre-read
nodes.meta: Missing default bundle -> HALT-006.

nodes.label: inject-skills
nodes.desc: Resolves changed files against the merged skill-bundles.yml registry and returns an ordered recommended_skills[] list prepended into an agent's system prompt. Glob-specificity (D9), content hints (D19), installed-skill filter (D10).
nodes.meta: Default-on (D21). Opt out with skill_routing: disabled.

nodes.label: plan-analyst
nodes.desc: Reads an implementation plan and returns a structured context object — task list, architectural layer, glossary constraints, tracer_required flag, reusable patterns.

nodes.label: build-implement-tdd / goal
nodes.desc: The core build loop. TDD: RED failing tests -> GREEN unit pass -> INTEGRATE real deps -> VERIFY per task. Goal: build first, test after. Mixed plans run TDD then goal in one outer iteration.
nodes.out: Working, tested code committed per task
nodes.meta: Dispatches scout + coder per task. R1 failure -> HALT-003.

nodes.label: coder
nodes.desc: Executes a single TDD task through all four cycle phases and produces working, tested code.
nodes.inp: One task + scout summary + injected recommended_skills[]
nodes.out: Code + tests passing all four phases
nodes.ctx: Runs with recommended_skills[] prepended into its system prompt and the scout file summary in context. Never dispatched directly by the PO-agent.

nodes.label: build-simplify
nodes.desc: Reviews implemented code for complexity that does not serve the acceptance criteria — premature abstractions, dead code, over-indirection. Auto-approves in autonomous mode.
nodes.meta: Often auto-triggered by the post-implement Stop hook.

nodes.label: build-review
nodes.desc: Adversarial diff review against acceptance criteria via the diff-reviewer agent; loops until clean.

nodes.label: diff-reviewer
nodes.desc: Adversarially reviews a branch diff against acceptance criteria — correctness bugs, edge cases, security, contract violations.

nodes.label: build-verify
nodes.desc: Full quality-gate pipeline: Gate 0 runs build-sensors internally, followed by build, lint, unit tests, integration tests, and conditional coverage. Each gate runs separately so failures are attributable.
nodes.out: Pass, fix-and-rerun, or escalate to refine
nodes.meta: R1 failure -> HALT-002. Step 9 compares invoked vs expected skills (F4 passport) — advisory only.

nodes.label: gate-scout
nodes.desc: Discovers build, lint, test and coverage commands by scanning project config files.

nodes.label: sensor-fixer
nodes.desc: Handles parsed Gate 0 sensor findings, runs a deterministic-autofix pre-pass, then dispatches build-resolve-finding per residual finding; escalates sonnet->opus on repeat failure.
nodes.ctx: Internal fixer loop for build-verify Gate 0. Tier-escalates model on the second failure for the same finding.

nodes.label: build-resolve-finding
nodes.desc: Per-finding decision tree: autofix / tech-skill route / safe-automated action / carry-over to draft PR.

nodes.label: build-fix-types
nodes.desc: Per-finding decision tree for Python type errors (pyright/mypy): narrow, annotate, generic, protocol, cast, or justified ignore.

nodes.label: build-fix-security
nodes.desc: Per-finding security repair for bandit/safety/pip-audit findings via a CWE-keyed table (autofix / refactor / suppress / carry-over).

nodes.label: definition-of-done
nodes.desc: The canonical, versioned Definition of Done shared across the pipeline — 12 automated items + 6 manual items.
nodes.inp: Referenced by build-verify, sensors, push, coder

nodes.label: build-push-to-git
nodes.desc: Creates atomic conventional commits (one per logical task) and pushes the feature branch. Auto-invokes build-create-pr in autonomous mode; existing-PR CI repairs return after push without recursive dispatch.
nodes.meta: Deny-list block -> HALT-005.

nodes.label: build-create-pr
nodes.desc: Generates the PR from spec artifacts, or reuses the current branch's open PR. Autonomous creation waits for build-fix-ci to confirm current-head green or return an explicit blocker.
nodes.out: PR identity and autonomous CI outcome

nodes.label: build-address-pr-comments
nodes.desc: Classifies every PR comment (human + bots/CI) as MUST-FIX / SHOULD-FIX / CONSIDER / OUT-OF-SCOPE, applies fixes, commits, replies.
nodes.out: Fix commits + threaded replies; structural -> HALT-003

nodes.label: brainstorming
nodes.desc: Structured divergent-convergent ideation to shape a raw feature request before a PRD exists.

nodes.label: create-prd
nodes.desc: Turns brainstorming output into a PRD — user stories, acceptance criteria, UI-required flag.

nodes.label: create-architecture
nodes.desc: Architecture Design Document from the PRD: system context, component & API design, data model, security, test strategy.

nodes.label: create-ux
nodes.desc: UX design doc — wireframes, screen states, interaction patterns, user-testing plan — when the PRD flags a UI.

nodes.label: create-prototype
nodes.desc: Interactive HTML prototype of new UI surfaces from PRD + architecture.

nodes.label: decompose
nodes.desc: Slices the shaped feature into vertically-sliced stories with acceptance criteria and draft Gherkin. Emits recommended_skills[] per sub-task.

nodes.label: create-acceptance-tests
nodes.desc: Refines draft Gherkin into 3-5 polished, manually testable acceptance scenarios per story.

nodes.label: stress-test-artifact
nodes.desc: Adversarial interview that stress-tests a phase artifact before committing to the next phase. Renamed from grill.

nodes.label: to-issues
nodes.desc: Publishes stories as GitHub Issues with a 10-dimension label taxonomy and emits created-issues.json. issue-to-project then adds them to the board.

nodes.label: issue-to-project
nodes.desc: Adds issues to the Projects v2 board and syncs lifecycle Status (Ready / In progress / In review / Done) as PRs open and merge.

nodes.label: context-scout
nodes.desc: Scans context/{REPO}/ directories for files relevant to a feature.

nodes.label: doc-writer
nodes.desc: Generates styled HTML review documents and writes canonical markdown artifacts.

nodes.label: prototype-builder
nodes.desc: Generates high-fidelity interactive HTML prototypes from design context and UX decisions.
nodes.ctx: Creative agent for visual UI generation.

nodes.label: po-reviewer
nodes.desc: Product-Owner perspective for Three-Amigos story review — value, scope, phase.
nodes.ctx: One of three Three-Amigos reviewer agents.

nodes.label: dev-reviewer
nodes.desc: Lead-Developer perspective — feasibility, dependencies, estimates, implementation risk.

nodes.label: qa-reviewer
nodes.desc: QA-Engineer perspective — testability, edge cases; produces draft Gherkin.

nodes.label: acceptance-writer
nodes.desc: Refines draft Gherkin scenarios into polished acceptance test cases.

nodes.label: orchestrate
nodes.desc: Autonomous entry for change requests. The loop classifies each Ready issue (loop.sh _classify_issue_type): type:change issues are dispatched here as makato-change:orchestrate --autonomous — everything else goes to the PO-agent. Owns the analyze→design→execute→resolve-review loop; no plan.md required.
nodes.inp: A type:change issue dispatched by loop
nodes.meta: Writes change-state-<N>.json + a workflow-state loop-compat stub. HALT-CH-001…004 on blocks.

nodes.label: analyze
nodes.desc: Compares current behaviour against requested changes, resolves open questions, updates the issue with refined requirements.

nodes.label: design
nodes.desc: Discovers affected code and plans the implementation approach, updating the issue with the strategy.

nodes.label: execute
nodes.desc: Implements the change, updates tests, runs verification, creates a PR. The write phase is isolated in the change-implementer sub-agent (#402) to keep the execute skill's main context clean.

nodes.label: resolve-review
nodes.desc: Resolves PR review feedback with code fixes or clarifying replies; updates issue status.

nodes.label: code-explorer
nodes.desc: Read-only codebase discovery for change requests — affected files, dependencies, conventions, specs context.

nodes.label: requirements-diff-analyzer
nodes.desc: Produces a structured requirements diff — side-by-side comparison, gaps, open questions.

nodes.label: test-analyzer
nodes.desc: Discovers and analyzes all tests affected by a change; maps tests to functionality, classifies impact.

nodes.label: code-reviewer
nodes.desc: Reviews implementation changes before PR — alignment with design, bugs, security, quality; severity-classified.

nodes.label: quality-guard
nodes.desc: Runs quality checks (lint, format, tests, coverage) after implementation and reports pass/fail.

nodes.label: map-codebase-context
nodes.desc: Map an unfamiliar area of a codebase — callers, dependencies, layers.

nodes.label: create-issue
nodes.desc: File a structured issue against the makato repo with the right template + labels.

nodes.label: makato-guide
nodes.desc: Discover installed plugins & skills and find the right tool for a task.
nodes.out: A pointer to the right skill

nodes.label: context7
nodes.desc: Retrieve up-to-date library/framework documentation via Context7. MANDATORY for every code-creating agent before writing code.

nodes.label: crafting-effective-readmes
nodes.desc: Create, update, or review project README/getting-started docs.

nodes.label: markdown
nodes.desc: Author/fix markdown, lint errors, code fences, tables.

nodes.label: writing-clearly-and-concisely
nodes.desc: Edit prose for clarity — Strunk's rules, avoids AI tells.

nodes.label: frontend-design
nodes.desc: Distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces — HTML/CSS, React, components, pages.

nodes.label: e2e-testing-patterns
nodes.desc: Reliable E2E suites with Playwright — POM, fixtures, waiting, network mocking.

nodes.label: webapp-testing
nodes.desc: Verify local web apps via the Playwright MCP browser — screenshots, DOM, console.

nodes.label: penpot-uiux-design
nodes.desc: Professional UI/UX design in Penpot — design systems, components, tokens, a11y.

nodes.label: langgraph-fundamentals
nodes.desc: StateGraph, nodes, edges, reducers — the LangGraph core model.

nodes.label: langgraph-agent-patterns
nodes.desc: Agent architectures on LangGraph.

nodes.label: langgraph-human-in-the-loop
nodes.desc: Interrupts & human-in-the-loop control.

nodes.label: langgraph-persistence
nodes.desc: Checkpointers & durable state.

nodes.label: langgraph-reflexion
nodes.desc: Reflexion / self-critique loops.

nodes.label: manage-postgres
nodes.desc: Postgres performance, query writing, schema design, administration.

nodes.label: dotx-schema-extractor
nodes.desc: Extract the schema from a Word .dotx template.

nodes.label: manage-microsoft-excel
nodes.desc: Read/write and process Excel workbooks.

nodes.label: manage-pdf
nodes.desc: Process and extract from PDF documents.

nodes.label: sagibeast-connect-testbox
nodes.desc: Connect to a sagibeast (CMAI) testbox environment.

nodes.label: sagibeast-create-testbox
nodes.desc: Provision a sagibeast testbox VM (Multipass / EC2 / Hetzner).

nodes.label: langfuse-instrument / ops / enrich
nodes.desc: Instrument, enrich & operate Langfuse observability for LangGraph agents (OTel OTLP).

nodes.label: makato-plugin-creator
nodes.desc: Scaffold a complete new makato plugin from an interview.

nodes.label: makato-skill-creator
nodes.desc: Scaffold a complete skill inside an existing plugin.

nodes.label: sync-from-upstream
nodes.desc: Sync content from an upstream repo into makato with naming remaps.

nodes.label: pre-commit hook
nodes.desc: Fires before every commit: runs pre-commit fast-lane sensors on staged files. Non-zero blocks the commit so sensor-fixer can repair.
nodes.meta: Timeout 30 s.

nodes.label: pre-push hook
nodes.desc: Fires before every push: runs the pre-push slow-lane (type checks, tests) on all files.
nodes.meta: Timeout 120 s.

nodes.label: post-implement hook
nodes.desc: After a completed implement session it scans build.jsonl and injects a message telling Claude to run /build-simplify next.

nodes.label: session-status hook
nodes.desc: On session open, prints one banner line per active workflow and a global HALT line.

nodes.label: validate.yml
nodes.desc: Runs on every PR to main: validates plugin structure, skill frontmatter, naming, self-containedness, ADR compliance, conventional-commit titles.

nodes.label: project-board-sync.yml
nodes.desc: Push-mode Projects v2 lifecycle sync — advances board Status on PR/issue events.

nodes.label: Merged PR
nodes.desc: The PO-agent exits only on a merged (or closed) PR. auto-merge-release-please.yml merges release PRs once required checks pass.

nodes.label: archive-spec.yml
nodes.desc: On PR merge: appends an Evolution Log row to specs/master/<domain>.md, moves the spec folder to specs/archive/, closes the linked issue.

nodes.label: release.yml
nodes.desc: Runs release-please on push to main to create/update a release PR and publish releases on merge.

nodes.label: auto-seed
nodes.desc: Pre-poll auto-seed pass. Each tick discovers open issues not yet at status:ready-for-dev: plan-tier:light → light-planner dispatch; full/change/untiered → Blocked + needs-human-review. Also runs thin-body reconciliation after light dispatch (#369–#373).
nodes.out: light issues → light-planner dispatch; full/untiered → Blocked + needs-human-review
nodes.meta: Toggle with MAKATO_LOOP_AUTOSEED_ON_POLL=0.

nodes.label: reconcile-orphaned
nodes.desc: Pre-poll pass (#368). Polls the board for In-progress cards that have no live local workflow-state (session died without cleanup) and moves them to Blocked + needs-human-review.
nodes.inp: Board In-progress items + local workflow-state files
nodes.meta: Toggle with MAKATO_LOOP_RECONCILE_ON_POLL=0. Standalone: loop reconcile-orphaned.

nodes.label: emit-reshape-request
nodes.desc: Serializes structural-failure evidence into a reshape context packet (#349) when structural_halt_cycles exceeds the threshold. Writes reshape-request.json so a future planning run has full failure context.
nodes.meta: Triggered by po-agent on recurrence; consumed by makato-plan skills.

nodes.label: change-implementer
nodes.desc: Isolated write-phase agent dispatched by execute (#396/#402) — the makato-change analogue of build's coder. Applies the code changes, and this is where technology skills are injected: it always runs the mandatory context7 lookup for any library the change touches, and invokes any recommended_skills[] forwarded from design.md before writing. (Unlike build, makato-change does not call inject-skills live — source-file routing is covered cross-plugin by makato-doc's doc-code-docs bundle.)
nodes.ctx: Write-capable sub-agent of change:execute. Analogue of build's coder. skill_routing default-on.

nodes.label: skill-judge
nodes.desc: Autonomous SKILL.md quality reviewer (#415). Scores a skill across 8 dimensions and returns a structured PASS/FAIL verdict per dimension.

nodes.label: fastapi
nodes.desc: FastAPI development patterns — routes, dependencies, Pydantic schemas, async handlers, testing with TestClient.

nodes.label: temporal-development
nodes.desc: Temporal workflow development — Workflows, Activities, Workers, schedules, error handling, testing.

statusText.operator: Operator starts the run from the terminal
statusText.board: loop reads the Projects v2 board (Status = Ready)
statusText.loop: loop checks HALT, polls the board, picks the next issue
statusText.poagent: PO-agent takes ownership of one issue
statusText.ci_poll: build-fix-ci owns CI repair; PO consumes green and polls review
statusText.build_refine: build-refine bridges the issue to plan.md
statusText.build_impl: implement loop: RED -> GREEN -> INTEGRATE -> VERIFY
statusText.coder: coder writes tested code for each task
statusText.build_verify: build-verify runs the full quality gate
statusText.build_push: atomic commits pushed to the feature branch
statusText.build_pr: draft PR opened from spec artifacts
statusText.gha_validate: validate.yml runs the PR CI gate
statusText.merge: PR merged to main — phase: done
statusText.gha_archive: archive-spec.yml archives the spec, closes the issue
